attestations.note: His life page there heads «День памяти: 23 октября» and no other day, so this row carries no second-day note. The day page prints no troparion and no kontakion for him.

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2791/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the entry is the same man: youngest son of the emperor Michael I Rangabe and of Prokopia the daughter of Nikephoros I, patriarch from 846 in succession to Methodius I, exiled by Bardas in 857, restored on 13 November 867 under Basil the Macedonian, and succeeded at his death by Photius the Great. Its heading prints «(799 - 878)» and the narrative gives both years, so a `dates` object with birth and death is proposed. The monastery it names — of the Archangel, once called τοῦ Ἀνατέλλοντος and now τοῦ Σατύρου — is named without a coordinate. No hymn is printed for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ήταν ο νεότερος γιος του βασιλιά Μιχαήλ Α' του Ραγκαβέ και της Προκοπίας… και γεννήθηκε το 799 μ.Χ.».

death.note: Two calendars, one year apart, and neither is chosen. saint.gr says «Πέθανε το 878 μ.Χ.» and heads its page «(799 - 878)». days.pravoslavie.ru's life for 23 октября ст. ст. says «Скончался он в 877 году, в монастыре», and dates his two patriarchates «(847-857; 867-877)»; the pair «(877-878)» its day line prints after his name is that line's own and is not read here as a span of death. Read 4 October 2026.
